answers.sql: SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN height = 840000 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN fee_sats ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN height = 840000 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN vsize ELSE 0 END)) - (SUM(CASE WHEN height = 839999 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN fee_sats ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN height = 839999 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN vsize ELSE 0 END))) * 100.0 / (SUM(CASE WHEN height = 839999 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN fee_sats ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN height = 839999 AND is_coinbase = 0 THEN vsize ELSE 0 END), 0)) FROM transactions

WITH matched_versions AS (SELECT DISTINCT version FROM (SELECT version FROM transactions WHERE height = 839999 AND is_coinbase = 0 INTERSECT SELECT version FROM transactions WHERE height = 840000 AND is_coinbase = 0)), sums AS (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fee_sats),0)*1.0 FROM transactions t WHERE height=839999 AND is_coinbase=0 AND t.version IN (SELECT version FROM matched_versions)) as fee_999, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vsize),0)*1.0 FROM transactions t WHERE height=839999 AND is_coinbase=0 AND t.version IN (SELECT version FROM matched_versions)) as vs_999, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fee_sats),0)*1.0 FROM transactions t WHERE height=840000 AND is_coinbase=0 AND t.version IN (SELECT version FROM matched_versions)) as fee_000, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(vsize),0)*1.0 FROM transactions t WHERE height=840000 AND is_coinbase=0 AND t.version IN (SELECT version FROM matched_versions)) as vs_000) SELECT (fee_000 / vs_000 - fee_999 / vs_999) * 100.0 / (fee_999 / vs_999) FROM sums
